description: This file provides functions for normalizing and collecting language hints for diff payloads, including handling supported languages, fallback mechanisms, and normalization of language hints within diff viewer payloads.

methods.name: normalizeSupportedLanguageHint
methods.description: Normalizes a language hint string to a supported language, returning undefined if invalid.

methods.name: filterSupportedLanguageHints
methods.description: Filters and normalizes a list of language hints, with fallback to 'text' if none are valid.

methods.name: collectDiffPayloadLanguageHints
methods.description: Collects language hints from a diff payload, including fileDiff, oldFile, and newFile.

methods.name: normalizeDiffPayloadFileLanguage
methods.description: Normalizes the language of a diff payload file, defaulting to 'text' if invalid.

methods.name: normalizeDiffViewerPayloadLanguages
methods.description: Normalizes all language hints within a diff viewer payload, including files and payload languages.
